name: The Sword
overview: Scripture presents the sword both as a literal instrument and a powerful spiritual symbol. Jesus instructs restraint with the sword, warning that those who live by it will perish by it, yet also acknowledges the necessity of being prepared for defense. The sword is further depicted as a divine authority used to execute justice against evil, emphasizing God's role in maintaining order. Ultimately, the Word of God is described as sharper than any two-edged sword, capable of discerning the deepest thoughts and intentions, illustrating the sword's spiritual significance as the 'sword of the Spirit.'
